evidence:
STATIC DESIGN (frozen task .qc-cache/hireops-lessons-2026-10-08-r5/task, input a79edbb8...): the reward is structurally graded, not all-or-nothing. tests/scoring.toml (byte-identical to frozen template rules/projects/webdev-task-template/tests/scoring.toml; tools/score.py and test.sh also identical by diff) sets gates render=0.0/constraints=0.0, weights functional 0.6/polish 0.2/visual 0.2, floor functional=0.05; score.py:41-48 zeroes reward only on a failed gate or functional<=0.05, otherwise weighted mean. Measured with tomllib: Functional = 15 binary criteria, mode=individual (one judge session each), weights 2-5.5 summing 61 (largest share hro_interview_places/hro_long_thread 0.0902); Polish = 5 binary, sum 9.5 (shares 0.158-0.211); Visual = 5 likert points=5 equal weight with anchors 5..1. Reward resolution is ~15 functional steps + 5 polish steps + 5x5 visual levels.
GATES (Colderwater lesson 4, keep gates simple): gates/render/judge.toml:25 = wrong password refused + seeded Recruiter signs in to a usable workspace; gates/constraints/judge.toml:25 = add one candidate via UI to the seeded Data Analyst job, reload still signed in and card present, Observer in an independent context sees exactly one card in Applied. Both exclude scored rules ('Permissions and workspace rules belong to scored outcomes'; 'Do not grade job opening, stage rules, conversations or live updates here'). This is a load/reload/server-backed gate, not a strictness gate; requirements trace to hireops_rules.md section 2 (name, email, source; bottom of Applied) and instruction.md:7,17. Staying signed in across reload is implied (rules section 6 drafts survive reload) though not stated literally - low risk.
SINGLE-PRECONDITION COLLAPSE: 13/15 functional criteria begin with 'open a new job', which the gate does not prove. Mitigated: functional/prompt.md:21 'Where your criterion needs a job and no job can be opened through the UI (opening is graded only in hro_intake_restart), use the seeded Product Designer job ... and Yuki Tanaka', and the same paragraph lets setup legs broken by another criterion's feature (add, single move, re-order, undo) be judged on actual state or left out; polish/prompt.md:24 has the same job fallback; hro_readonly_roles (functional judge.toml:112) excludes kinds whose staff control failed; hro_messaging:121, hro_unread_seen:148 and hro_long_thread:139 carry fallbacks when Tomas/Noor legs fail. So no single non-gate feature zeroes most criteria. The global browser gate repeated in each scored session (functional/prompt.md:15-17, polish/prompt.md:11-12, visual/prompt.md:11-12) is the same check as the gate suite.
RESIDUAL DISCRIMINATION RISKS (unmeasured): (a) every binary criterion is a long conjunction (hro_intake_restart:31 bundles job validation, email-field refusal display and restart durability; hro_undo:85 eight steps; hro_bulk:76 nine steps); a partial app that handles most of each flow but misses one edge earns 0 for the whole weight, so realistic partial apps may cluster near functional 0. (b) Floor arithmetic: hro_drafts or hro_activity alone = 2/61 = 0.0328 and hro_reject_reopen alone = 3/61 = 0.0492, all <= 0.05, so an app passing only one of these gets reward 0 regardless of polish/visual; any single criterion of weight >= 3.5 (0.0574) clears the floor. The floor is template policy, not a task defect. (c) hro_pol_live_board/live_thread are 0 if live updates never arrive, coupling polish to the functional live-update feature (stated in the criteria; bounded).
MEASUREMENT: qc/runs/hireops-lessons-2026-10-08-r5/raw-evidence-index.json scope states 'Full configured grading/workload, reward discrimination/ranking and Oracle/target scores are absent.' Verified hashes: results/workspace.json 662829b4...3797c16 and results/via-solve.log 238ed0e5...14ff98dd match the index; frozen solution/app/server.js 4fc5d2c4..., src/index.js 708f94cb..., public/js/board.js a177dc0c..., solve.sh 1df2ed04... match matching_source_files. That evidence is a scripted golden driver (26 PASS groups) - not a judge run, not mutated weak-app runs, not a model score - so it does not measure spread. REVIEW_POLICY requires a hash-bound reward-discrimination record before local clearance; none exists. No Oracle, model or portal score is claimed.
COLDERWATER LESSONS checked: lesson 2 (weights) - functional weights 2-5.5 while every judge.toml comment (line 17/23) says '1.0 standard, 1.5 important, 2.0 core'; scheme/documentation mismatch belongs to row 44 but bears on the customer audit's failed-vs-passed weight comparison; lesson 4 (simple gates) satisfied; lessons 7/14 (timing void handling) defined in functional/prompt.md:29 and polish/prompt.md:18 (void definition, up to two repeats), so timing races should not collapse scores; lesson 9 (report each step) present at functional/prompt.md:31-33; lesson 11 (infra crash zeroes a dimension) - NOT EXERCISED handling returns 0 per outcome, which would flatten spread on infra failure; unmeasured.
WORKBOOK/SKILL: Quality Checks row 41 (#40, block E) 'The rubric produces a spread across partial-quality apps, not all-or-nothing.'; Internal Quality Checks row 41 annotation column E is empty. references/quality-checks.md #40: 'A single all-or-nothing gate, or criteria that all depend on one precondition, collapses the signal.' The design avoids both; actual spread is unmeasured, so this is not upgraded to Pass.
counterexample: Unmeasured plausible collapse: a partial app with a working board, single moves, notes and messaging but one missed edge in each flow (e.g. email refusal not shown at the field, multi-card order by selection, undo not refused after a colleague's re-order, unread count off by one) fails every long conjunctive binary criterion, so functional <= 0.05 and reward = 0, identical to a dead app; likewise an app passing only hro_reject_reopen (3/61 = 0.049) scores 0. If partial apps instead pass some whole criteria the structure yields spread. No weak-app or model run exists to show which happens.
suggested_fix: Before clearance, record hash-bound reward-discrimination evidence: grade 2-3 mutated golden apps (e.g. undo disabled, live updates disabled, role checks removed) with the configured verifier or scripted criterion legs and confirm intermediate, ordered rewards; if partial apps collapse to 0, split the longest conjunctive criteria by independent promise rather than changing weights or the template floor.
